name: imhere-cdk
description: CDK app to deploy Lambda and API Gateway /hello in ap-east-1

scripts.deploy: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (-not $env:AWS_PROFILE) { $env:AWS_PROFILE='dam' }; if (-not $env:AWS_REGION) { $env:AWS_REGION='ap-east-1' }; $env:AWS_PAGER=''; aws sts get-caller-identity --no-cli-pager > $null; cdk deploy"
scripts.site:bucket: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:AWS_PAGER=''; $bn = (aws cloudformation describe-stacks --no-cli-pager --stack-name HelloApiStack --region ap-east-1 --query \"Stacks[0].Outputs[?contains(OutputKey,'SiteBucketName')].OutputValue\" --output text); Write-Output $bn"
scripts.site:url: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:AWS_PAGER=''; aws cloudformation describe-stacks --no-cli-pager --stack-name HelloApiStack --region ap-east-1 --query \"Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='HttpApiBaseUrl'].OutputValue\" --output text"
scripts.site:sync: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:AWS_PROFILE='dam'; $env:AWS_REGION='ap-east-1'; $env:AWS_PAGER=''; $bn = (npm run -s site:bucket); if (-not $bn) { Write-Error 'SiteBucketName not found from stack outputs. Deploy stack first.'; exit 1 }; aws s3 sync web \"s3://$bn\" --delete --no-cli-pager; Write-Output \"Synced to s3://$bn\";"
